title: File upload catalog (v1.0)
description: The FileUpload component of the file upload sample.
instructions: This catalog holds only the FileUpload component. Build the rest of the UI from the basic catalog, which is the surface's default catalog in `createSurface`. Each FileUpload component MUST set `catalogId` to this catalog's id.

component.description: FileUpload component with Host-Delegated IoC upload callback.

label.description: The text label or prompt displayed on the file upload drop zone (e.g., "Drag and drop files or click to upload").

accept.description: Comma-separated list of allowed MIME types or file extensions (e.g., "image/*, application/pdf").

maxSize.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes for each uploaded file.

multiple.description: Whether multiple files can be selected and uploaded concurrently. Defaults to false.
